usedFor: Applivery reports new builds, and TRIGGERcmd runs “Trigger Command” on your computers when “New Build Uploaded” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Build Uploaded” in Applivery, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A fresh upload can start any command you have already set up on your own computers.

watchOut: “New Build Uploaded” in Applivery covers any app in the workspace unless you choose one, so pick the app first.
